posts.text:
The biggest mistake AI teams make?

They test whether an AI Agent works.

Not whether it can be trusted.

An agent can look brilliant in a demo and still fail the moment real users start interacting with it.

That's why AI evaluation is becoming one of the most important skills in AI.

I recently came across the Evaluating AI Agents Bootcamp by Packt, led by Ammar Mohanna, PhD.

In this live hands-on session, you'll learn how modern AI teams evaluate:

✅ Agent reliability
✅ Tool selection & planning quality
✅ Failure recovery
✅ Adversarial robustness
✅ Production readiness

For the AI engineers, builders, founders, and tech professionals in my network, this is a topic worth paying attention to.
